AnubarakNerubianArmor.name: Nerubian Armor
AnubarakNerubianArmor.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

AnubarakCombatStyleLegionOfBeetles.name: Legion of Beetles
AnubarakCombatStyleLegionOfBeetles.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

GenericTalentRegenerationMaster.name: Regeneration Master
GenericTalentRegenerationMaster.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30. Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

AnubarakMasteryBedOfBarbs.name: Bed of Barbs
AnubarakMasteryBedOfBarbs.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

AnubarakMasteryShedExoskeletonHardenCara.name: Shed Exoskeleton
AnubarakMasteryShedExoskeletonHardenCara.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

AnubarakMasteryUnderkingBurrowCharge.name: Underking
AnubarakMasteryUnderkingBurrowCharge.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

AnubarakCombatStyleChitinousPlating.name: Chitinous Plating
AnubarakCombatStyleChitinousPlating.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

AnubarakSubterraneanShield.name: Subterranean Shield
AnubarakSubterraneanShield.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 point Shield for 5 seconds.

AnubarakMasteryLeechingScarabs.name: Leeching Scarabs
AnubarakMasteryLeechingScarabs.description: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

AnubarakLocustSwarm.name: Locust Swarm
AnubarakLocustSwarm.description: Deal 68 damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

AnubarakHeroicAbilityCocoon.name: Cocoon
AnubarakHeroicAbilityCocoon.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

AnubarakMasteryUrticatingSpines.name: Urticating Spines
AnubarakMasteryUrticatingSpines.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

AnubarakBurningBeetles.name: Burning Beetles
AnubarakBurningBeetles.description: Deal 21 damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 damage per second to nearby enemies.

AnubarakAcidDrenchedMandibles.name: Acid-Drenched Mandibles
AnubarakAcidDrenchedMandibles.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

AnubarakMasteryEpicenterBurrowCharge.name: Epicenter
AnubarakMasteryEpicenterBurrowCharge.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

AnubarakDebilitation.name: Debilitation
AnubarakDebilitation.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

AnubarakScarabHostBeetleJuiced.name: Beetle, Juiced
AnubarakScarabHostBeetleJuiced.description: Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health. Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

AnubarakLocustSwarmHiveMaster.name: Hive Master
AnubarakLocustSwarmHiveMaster.description: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165 damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80 health.

AnubarakCocoonCryptweave.name: Cryptweave
AnubarakCocoonCryptweave.description: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60 damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

AnubarakTheTraitorKing.name: The Traitor King
AnubarakTheTraitorKing.description: Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor. Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

GenericTalentRewind.name: Rewind
GenericTalentRewind.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
